messages.name: Bryan Laue
messages.text: Draft awards — Best Haul: Dirty Birds (Ben), seven picks, real talent throughout. Grand Larceny: Seth McGowan at 4.05 (Steven), Jonathan Taylor's handcuff in the fourth. Biggest Swing: Jack Strand at 4.07 (Bryan), one pick all night on an undrafted D-II legend. Fragile Cargo: Jordyn Tyson at 1.07 (Tim). Nominative Determinism: Jeremiyah Love at 1.01 (Tim), named his son Jeremiayah Love in July. Menacingly Boring: TDs in Your Face (Lyndsey), three depth picks, zero urgency, still the favorite.

messages.name: Aaron Murnan
messages.text: Trade pick protection language: Tim’s first is protected. If Tim’s 2027 pick is the 1.01 it will be swapped with Ben’s 2027 first. As a requirement of the deal Risky Business must maintain possession of Tim’s 2027 until the 2027 draft order is set. IF Title Chase trades Ben’s 2027 1st prior to this time, it will void the protection on Tim’s pick making it an unprotected pick.
